title: Tyler Cameron on ‘DWTS’ and Rebuilding His Career, One House (and One Dance) at a Time
summary: The former 'Bachelorette' star opens up to The Hollywood Reporter about returning to primetime with the ABC reality dance series, building a life with his fiancée, Tate Madden, honoring his late mother on the dance floor and teasing his next HGTV series, 'Let's Go Back to Your Place.'
